newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firm at 2,970-3,020 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firm at 2,970-3,020 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev edged up in light, afternoon interbank trade to close at 2,970-3,020 per dollar from the morning's 3,100 due to increased dollar supply, dealers said.
"Final clients were offering foreign currency to meet pending lev payments. However, demand was not large due to low lev liquidity, and the lev regained around 100 from opening," a dealer said.
The higher foreign currency supply tempered the lev fall in the morning, which was caused by the longer value date of spot-deals, traders said. The lev closed on Wednesday at 2,930-2,950 per dollar.
The value date of Thursday's spot deals is Tuesday because banks in the U.S. will be closed on Monday for President's Day. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
